---
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<iframe id="z-frame" src="../apps/z_table.html"
        style="width:100%; height:820px; border:0; display:block;"
        title="Standard normal table (z-table)"></iframe>

<script>
// The app reports its own height; the iframe is resized to fit it,
// so only the page scrolls
window.addEventListener("message", function (e) {
  var frame = document.getElementById("z-frame");
  if (!frame || e.source !== frame.contentWindow) return;
  if (e.data && e.data.type === "z-table-height") {
    frame.style.height = (e.data.height + 2) + "px";
  }
});
</script>
```
